summary.text: Ray Seigfried has represented Delaware Senate District 5 since 2025, after serving in the Delaware House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: According to his official page, Seigfried was born and raised in Philadelphia, holds a bachelor's degree in political science from Bloomsburg University and a master's degree from Antioch University, and lives in Arden.
The page says he spent 25 years at ChristianaCare, rising to senior vice president, and now teaches health policy and business at Arcadia University.
